annotations.title: Get the price of a domain for sale on HugeDomains

description: Get the buy-it-now listing for one specific domain name for sale on HugeDomains.com: USD price, TLD, length, tags, the purchaseUrl where a person buys it, and estimated monthly payment plan terms when offered. Use when the person names an exact domain (e.g. "how much is example.com?"). This is an aftermarket listing lookup, not a registrar availability check; a not-found error means HugeDomains does not sell that domain.

domainName.description: Exact domain name including the TLD, e.g. example.com

name: get_aftermarket_domain_listing
